verdict_text: YES. The script drops blocks 2, 6, 10, 14, maps the surviving blocks in original order to contiguous indices 0..11 via `renumber` (old 3→2, 15→11, etc.), copies tensors by reference so values, shapes and dtypes are untouched, passes the 4 non-block tensors through unchanged, and writes a single `out/T1/model.safetensors`. The two assertions (surviving layer index set equals `{0..11}`, which subsumes "no blocks 12–15 remain" and "exactly 12 blocks", and total tensor count equals 184) run before `mkdir`/`save_file`, so a failure aborts with a non-zero exit and no output written.
